channel.title: Unstream Changelog
channel.description: What's new in Unstream — a running log of shipped features and improvements.

item.title: Release pages
item.description: Releases now have their own pages: every format and price we can find, on every platform that carries them, with an estimate of how much of it reaches the artist. Release alerts point here now instead of sending you straight to one shop.
item.content:encoded:
Releases now have their own pages: every format and price we can find, on every platform that carries them, with an estimate of how much of it reaches the artist. Release alerts point here now instead of sending you straight to one shop.

See it on Unstream

item.title: Share your saved artists list
item.description: Make your saved artists list public and share a link with friends — they can browse who you support on Unstream without signing in. Set a username in Settings, then toggle sharing from your dashboard.
item.content:encoded:
Make your saved artists list public and share a link with friends — they can browse who you support on Unstream without signing in. Set a username in Settings, then toggle sharing from your dashboard.

See it on Unstream

item.title: Sync saved artists on Mac and iOS
item.description: Sign in on the Mac menu bar app or iOS app to sync your saved artists across devices. Saved artists from the web, extension, and native apps all stay in sync.
item.content:encoded:
Sign in on the Mac menu bar app or iOS app to sync your saved artists across devices. Saved artists from the web, extension, and native apps all stay in sync.

See it on Unstream

item.title: Save artists on web
item.description: You can now save artists you care about on unstream.stream — sign in and tap the heart on any artist page to keep them in your dashboard.
item.content:encoded:
You can now save artists you care about on unstream.stream — sign in and tap the heart on any artist page to keep them in your dashboard.

See it on Unstream

item.title: Search from your dashboard
item.description: Find a new artist without leaving the app. The Saved Artists section on your dashboard has its own search bar that takes you straight to results.
item.content:encoded:
Find a new artist without leaving the app. The Saved Artists section on your dashboard has its own search bar that takes you straight to results.

item.title: Add Unstream to your Home Screen
item.description: Unstream is now a Progressive Web App. Add it to your Home Screen on iOS or Android for a full-screen, app-like experience — no browser chrome, faster loads, and offline-ready.
item.content:encoded:
Unstream is now a Progressive Web App. Add it to your Home Screen on iOS or Android for a full-screen, app-like experience — no browser chrome, faster loads, and offline-ready.

See it on Unstream

item.title: Browser extension notifications
item.description: When the extension detects a new artist during playback, it sends a browser notification showing where to support them directly.
item.content:encoded:
When the extension detects a new artist during playback, it sends a browser notification showing where to support them directly.

item.title: AI music policy badges
item.description: See which platforms ban or restrict AI-generated music right on the search results. Badges for banned (🚫) and AI-cautious (🛡️) platforms, with a legend at the bottom of each result.
item.content:encoded:
See which platforms ban or restrict AI-generated music right on the search results. Badges for banned (🚫) and AI-cautious (🛡️) platforms, with a legend at the bottom of each result.

item.title: Public API v1
item.description: Developers can now build on top of Unstream. The public API supports artist search, artist lookup, URL resolution, and a full platform list — with API key auth and tiered rate limiting.
item.content:encoded:
Developers can now build on top of Unstream. The public API supports artist search, artist lookup, URL resolution, and a full platform list — with API key auth and tiered rate limiting.

See it on Unstream

item.title: No-JavaScript search
item.description: Unstream now works without JavaScript. The search experience is fully server-rendered for accessibility, crawlers, and anyone who prefers a leaner web.
item.content:encoded:
Unstream now works without JavaScript. The search experience is fully server-rendered for accessibility, crawlers, and anyone who prefers a leaner web.

item.title: iOS app coming soon
item.description: An iOS app is in the works — search for artists, save your favorites, and get release alerts on your iPhone and iPad. Stay tuned.

item.title: Claim your artist page
item.description: Indie artists can now claim and verify their page for free — every artist we feature in our daily posts has one. Claim yours and get all your direct-support links in one place.

item.description: The Mac app now scrobbles to ListenBrainz — open-source music tracking that actually respects your data.
